@common.sizeUnit.byte.sameAsSourceJustification: Dutch uses the same word and plural: macOS Finder nl SP27/SP28 render byte / bytes.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteBinary.sameAsSourceJustification: Dutch macOS Finder writes the same unit symbols (nl Finder SP24–SP26: GB, MB, KB); SI symbols are international, so Dutch keeps them as English does.

@common.sizeUnit.kilobyteSi.sameAsSourceJustification: SI symbol kB (lowercase k) is international and identical in Dutch; it stays distinct from the binary KB, as in English.
